bio: The red-brick Crowne Plaza Reading hotel overlooks a peaceful stretch of the River Thames, 15 minutes' walk from Reading town centre.  Nestled among trees on the banks of the River Thames, you'll find Crowne Plaza Reading an elegant retreat primed for business success, lavish banquets and a strategic base for unlocking London.  If the weather is warm and sunny, enjoy a beautifully presented Afternoon Tea on our river-facing terrace. We've partnered with award-winning tea brand, Novus, for a truly spectacular Afternoon Tea experience.
